Anthropic Renames Claude Tiers and Drops 5-Hour Limit on Top Plan

Anthropic announced updates on October 30, renaming Max 5x to Max at $100/month and Max 20x to Ultra at $200/month, while removing the 5-hour session limit for verified Ultra accounts. Prices remain unchanged, weekly limits stay at 10x Pro's allowance, and most subscribers see the change right away. Users praised the shift, with one analyst calling it 'super cool' for enabling longer projects without interruptions, amid buzz over a possible Fable 5.5 model.

2 hours ago · News · 6.4K posts

Google Unveils Gemini 4 Carbon, Tops AI Intelligence Index

Announced on October 28, 2026, Gemini 4 Carbon scores 59 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0, edging out Claude Opus 5.5 at 58 and GPT-6 Astra at 57. It shines in cybersecurity tasks like vulnerability detection (88.2% on SEC-bench Pro) and long-horizon reasoning, with strong marks in science, math, and agentic coding. The model rolls out first to trusted cyber defenders via the Fairwind Program, with wider access and pricing at $2 per million input tokens coming soon. Elon Musk called it 'Impressive,' and DeepMind's Demis Hassabis celebrated with 'No.1 💎.'

2 days ago · News · 70K posts

Claude Opus 5.5 Shines in Coding and Agent Tasks for Developers

Anthropic launched Claude Opus 5.5 on September 22, 2026, as the first in its 5.5 family, designed for long-running agentic coding and knowledge work with a 1 million token context window. Priced at $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens—20% less than prior Opus on many tasks—it excels in benchmarks and extended workflows amid 18 new models from 11 vendors in October alone. Users share tips like defining goals upfront and letting it self-correct, with some replacing software subscriptions via custom tools built on it, while comparisons show it outperforming rivals like OpenAI’s GPT-6.1 Terra in coding quality.
